direction: Counterform-inspired personal portfolio: deep green, light italic Fraunces, Geist labels and coral-to-peach halftone fields.

assets.horizonPoster: Paper Counterform reference shader field, reused from the user's design file. No interface text is baked in. The live field is original procedural GLSL.

implementation: Home / Posts / Explore remain ordinary portfolio routes. The homepage Portfolio section links to the lazy-loaded café world app at /world. Artwork switches are local to the hero, with static motion under prefers-reduced-motion and a poster fallback when WebGL is unavailable.
